use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Text.Json.Nodes

let text =
    "{{\"name\": \"Ada\", \"age\": 36, "
    "\"languages\": [\"Ada\", \"ghūl\"]}}"

let parsed =
    JsonNode.parse(text, null, _[System.Text.Json.JsonDocumentOptions])!
        .as_object()
let languages = parsed["languages"]!.as_array()

write_line("name = {parsed["name"]!.get_value[string]()}")
write_line("age = {parsed["age"]!.get_value[int]()}")
write_line("first language = {languages[0]!.get_value[string]()}")

let created = JsonObject(null)

created["title"] = JsonValue.create("Rosetta Code", null)
created["year"] = JsonValue.create(2007, null)

let tags = JsonArray(null)

tags.add(JsonValue.create("wiki", null))
tags.add(JsonValue.create("programming", null))

created["tags"] = tags

write_line(created.to_json_string(null))
